}}'''Balthamel''' (BAHL-thah-mell; /ˈbɑːɫ.θaˌmɛɫ/), formerly known as '''Eval Ramman''', was one of the thirteen [[Forsaken]] trapped at [[Shayol Ghul]] due to the [[Dragon]]'s sealing. He was a historian during the [[Age of Legends]], specializing in the study of vanished cultures.

==Appearance==
[[File:Balthamel ccg.jpg|thumb|right|Balthamel from the [[CCG]].]]
Being sealed close to the surface, time wore away at his body, leaving his skin so rotted that he covered all of himself in a shroud, his face a grinning mask. Further, he was no longer able to speak.

==Strength==
In "The Wheel of Time Companion" his strength level is described as {{opsl|3}}, one of the highest levels known, but still below the Dragon and some other male Forsaken.

==History==
Eval Ramman had a bad temper. That, combined with his great strength in the [[One Power]], almost earned him a sentence of being bound with the Power to keep him from violence. He was also fond of women and gambling, cheating in the latter to impress the former. Lured by the promise of endless life, the historian was easily swayed to join [[The Shadow]] during the middle years of the [[Collapse]].
[[Image:Balthamel.jpg|left|thumb|150px|Balthamel portrait done by Seamas Gallagher]]
During his time as one of the [[Chosen]], he ran an extensive intelligence network, bested only by that of [[Moghedien]], and committed several great atrocities - for example, he raised and organized breeding camps for humans to be fed to the Trolloc armies.

When [[Lews Therin Telamon]] and the [[Hundred Companions]] struck at [[Shayol Ghul]] to seal the [[Bore]], he was there along with twelve other of the most powerful Chosen, and imprisoned for three thousand years before his release in [[998 NE]].

==Activities==
[[File:Balthamel.JPG|200px|thumb|right|Balthamel masked]]
Soon after his release, he and [[Aginor]] confronted the [[Dragon Reborn]], [[Rand al'Thor]], at the [[Eye of the World]]. After manhandling [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], Balthamel was confronted by [[The Green Man|Someshta]] who would not allow them to cause destruction in his home. Balthamel burned the Green Man badly, striking a mortal blow to the nearly immortal being. But Balthamel started to rot as organic weeds, fungi and such grew all over him from the touch of the Green Man, subsequently killing him.{{ref/book|1|50}}

== Aran'gar==
Later the Dark One reincarnated Balthamel in a new female body, calling him/her [[Aran'gar]].{{ref/book|6|p}}

Aran'gar uses the alias Halima Sarinov in [[Salidar]].

As Halima, Aran'gar poses as the secretary to [[Delana Mosalaine]], a [[Gray Ajah|gray]] sister who is secretly [[Black Ajah]].  

Halima makes herself useful to [[Egwene al'Vere]] who experiences blinding headaches that are brought on by Halima using ''[[saidin]]''. She uses this to sleep near Egwene and also be near her to undermine her dealings with the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]].

She also kills several Aes Sedai and their [[Warder|warders]] to keep her cover in place.

Once Egwene is captured by [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]], the remaining rebel Aes Sedai begin questioning odd behavior from Halima as well as Delana. One of the [[Asha'man]], [[Jahar Narishma]], detects the use of saidin and [[Romanda Cassin|Romanda]] orders Halima's arrest but she and Delana escape and take refuge with [[Graendal]]. Rand finds Graendal and unknowingly destroys Halima and Delana when he used [[balefire]] to destroy Graendal's fortress, though Graendal is able to escape. <ref>''[[Knife of Dreams/Chapter 37|Knife of Dreams, Chapter 37]]''</ref>
